Subject: Technical deep-dive: initial topology & perf notes (recap)

Alex / Marissa,

Thanks for the alignment. Recap from my side after reviewing the notes + goals. I've kept this intentionally actionable: short bullets with assumptions, recommended topology, and next testing steps.

Assumptions (please flag if anything is incorrect):
- Target P95 <= 150ms, peak sustained throughput ~800 req/s, bursts to 1.5k req/s.
- Typical context window: ~1.5k tokens. Average output length ~80 tokens.
- Model family: 13B decoder; plan to evaluate quantized 13B vs 7B ensemble for cost/latency tradeoffs.

Recommended deployment topology:
- Dedicated Redwood pool (GPU-backed) in us-west region behind a VPC endpoint to meet isolation/regulatory needs.
- Multi-node inference group with warm KV cache and request-local batching tuned to keep tail latency low. Suggest keeping batch sizes small (4-8) for user-facing endpoints and larger for background reranks.
- Autoscaling policy: keep a minimum of N=4 warm workers (to maintain KV cache hit rates) and scale to N=24 under load. (Exact GPU counts depend on model quantization and chosen instance class.)
- Fallbacks: lightweight 7B quantized variant for aggressive cost/latency fallbacks; automatic routing by latency SLO.

Performance expectations / notes:
- With a well-warmed KV cache and quantized 13B, expect P95 in the 120-180ms range on A100-equivalent hardware for 1.5k token contexts (subject to input variability).
- If strict P95 <=150ms is mandatory, we should plan a short evaluation comparing: (A) 13B quantized multi-GPU shards + cache warmup, (B) 7B quantized ensemble with aggressive batching.

Data & compliance notes:
- We can run Private deployment (VPC + customer control plane) to satisfy SOC2 / audit-log separation. KMS/HSM integrations supported for key management.

Immediate next steps (owners):
1) Acme to provide anonymized sample payloads and 7-day traces. Owner: Alex (by Mon, Mar 9)
2) Redwood to run two short perf runs (A and B above) with identical load profile; results to include p50/p95/p99 and cost per 1k tokens. Owner: Vivek (target: results by Fri, Mar 13)
3) Share architecture diagram and test plan. Owner: Dylan

Attachments: acme_perf_matrix.csv (perf matrix template)

- Preferred KMS provider (Aws KMS / customer-managed HSM)?

I'll sync with Marissa to get the test window scheduled once we have the payloads.
